# Revised Claims

**The audit trail of what Phase 9 changed.** A competitor study that hides its own errors is worth less than no study at all, so every correction is recorded rather than silently applied.

![Revised claims](../_exports/charts/phase9/p9_08_revised_claims.png)

## RC-01 — FALSIFIED

> **Phase 0 claimed:** No competitor can prove a large Indian institution runs on their software.

**What falsified it.** EcoSync (TBI-KIET); Accubate (NSRCOM, NASSCOM); VentureLink (ICUBE, Univ. of Toronto)

**Correction.** Narrowed to: no competitor demonstrates a LARGE INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with named referees and third-party verification.

**Gaps affected.** GAP-13

## RC-02 — FALSIFIED

> **Phase 0 claimed:** Exactly zero competitors have an IPR module.

**What falsified it.** Wellspring for Tech Transfer; Helikon Labs; Commercify; SINT.OTRI

**Correction.** Narrowed to: dedicated IP platforms exist but are not joined to incubation programme management, and none has Indian data residency. This forced a new competitor category (tech_transfer) into this phase.

**Gaps affected.** GAP-01, GAP-06

## RC-03 — RESOLVED

> **Phase 0 claimed:** RiserNest - Europe (unverified); VentureLink - Not found; EcoSync - login-gated, unverified.

**What falsified it.** All three verified against live vendor pages

**Correction.** RiserNest: Rotterdam, founded 2024, €399–1,500/mo. VentureLink: founded inside a University of Toronto incubator, ~$225/mo, NAMED_REFERENCE customer. EcoSync: Opernova Technologies LLP, VENDOR_CLAIM customer TBI-KIET.

**Gaps affected.** GAP-13

## RC-04 — EXPANDED

> **Phase 0 claimed:** The Global/ folder contains 4 vendors (Elsevier Pure, IdeaScale, Innoloft, Incu).

**What falsified it.** n/a - this is a coverage gap, not a false claim

**Correction.** Expanded to 16 global vendors across the four categories the spec names, plus a fifth (tech_transfer) that verification required.

## RC-05 — SUPERSEDED BY LATER EVIDENCE

> **Phase 0 claimed:** DPIIT recognition criteria are stable.

**What falsified it.** DPIIT Gazette Notification 108(E), 4 February 2026

**Correction.** The turnover threshold for Startup recognition was revised from ₹100 crore to ₹200 crore. This changes the recognised population that Phase 3A measured and that the whole ecosystem competes within.

## Why this section exists

Two of the five corrections were outright false claims — not imprecise ones. A claim that *zero of eleven competitors have an IPR module* is the kind of sentence that survives into a pitch deck unchallenged, because nobody re-checks it. Four dedicated tech-transfer platforms exist and were simply not found in Phase 0.

The surviving claim is narrower and **stronger**: those platforms exist, and none is joined to incubation programme management, and none has Indian data residency. That is a real gap with a real reason, rather than an artefact of incomplete searching.

`build/data_p9_competitors.py` carries a regression guard: a gap may only be marked `SURVIVES UNCHANGED` if research genuinely failed to falsify it.
